title: PWR-B power mezzanine (PWR_BRANCH_SW + USB_POWER_SW): LNA and USB branch switches, monitors, harness headers
note: W2 PCB-PWRB, W2 B2B. Generated by build/kicad/boards/PWR_B/make_spec.py (do not hand-edit; rerun it). Placement and the scripted copper are design choices of these packages (build/15 rows W2 PCB-PWRB and W2 B2B); the J209 pin map is the graph (pcb/generated/b2b-nets.json contacts). KiCad DRC, the audits and check_boards are CI/model results. Not a fabrication release; mezzanine fit, heat and every bench gate stay OPEN.

layers.source: build/15 Шари (4-layer JLC04161H-7628, 1 oz outer) and mechanical/generated/contract/boards.json stackup

plan.F.Cu: parts (top side only), LAB5 trunk and Kelvin copper, signals, GND pour
plan.In1.Cu: solid GND plane (layer type power: the router puts only vias through it)
plan.B.Cu: B2B half J209 (bottom), its GND spine and contact escapes, LAB5 stubs, signals, GND pour

rules_note: Project rules live in the committed PWR_B.kicad_pro (generated by make_spec.py): the project defaults of pcb/generated/netclasses.json project_defaults (track 0.15 / clearance 0.15, via 0.6 / 0.3, copper-edge 0.3, hole-hole 0.5) and its net classes SIG (Default), PWR1A, PWR2A, PWR3A with the outer minimum width as track width. pcb/rules/jlc-4l-1oz.kicad_dru is not copied: board_gen refuses rules_file until it copies and hashes it.

list.source: one board per device; template refs and nets are the graph refs and nets (pcb/generated/partition.json domains PWR_BRANCH_SW, USB_POWER_SW)

instances.spares_source: no spare board planned (build/15 W2 PCB-PWRB); a fab panel minimum is a purchasing matter

zones.why: GND plane (layer type power, a plane in the DSN): the scripted vias of every SMD GND pad and the THT GND pins join it

second GND plane (power layer); solid pad connection: a THT GND pin of J207 had one thermal spoke left on both planes (route run 42417213682). Cost: the THT GND pins of J201-J508 join four GND layers without thermal relief, so their hole fill and solder joints are an assembly gate (OPEN, build/15 W2 PCB-PWRB)

post_route_zones.why: solid pad connection: thermal spokes of THT header GND pins were starved between the pins (route run 42414083566); the solder-joint cost of solid THT connections is an assembly gate (OPEN, see GND-In2)

edge_keepout.why: rule-area strips (half-width 0.2) on every outline and cutout edge: the router keeps its copper 0.35 mm off the edge, above the project copper-to-edge 0.3 (route run 42414083566 had 0.23)

height_zones.why: hB 5.5 (pcb/partition-spec.json parameters.hB): parts on the top side; heights from heights below
bottom side: only the B2B half J209 in the PWR-A to PWR-B gap (stack 5.0; mechanical/params/boards.json PWR_B b2b.bottom_side)

J209.reason: J209 contact escapes (Samtec LSHM-150, pads 0.30 mm at 0.50 mm pitch, a GND or rail neighbour 0.20 mm away): every contact carries at most 1 A (b2b_i_pin_A, pcb/partition-spec.json b2b.i_pin_note), its stub is 0.25 mm wide inside the row and 0.35 mm (PWR1A, 1 A) beyond it up to its via, where the LAB5 contacts meet on the 2.0 mm LAB5-PLATE; the 1.85 mm of PWR3A does not fit between 0.30 mm pads

b2b_pin_map.connector: J209 (Samtec LSHM-150-02.5-L-DV-A-N-K-TR, graph ref of design/E2.json, bottom side)

mate.pin_map: pin n of J208 (PWR-A) meets pin n+1 of J209 (PWR-B) for n odd and pin n-1 for n even; the map is its own inverse
mate.rule: PWR_A has no board of record yet (W2 PCB-PWRA-2 not run: area study); when it has one, its spec places J208 on the PWR-A top under J209 (J209 = J208 mirrored about the strip axis, so J209 pad m lies over J208 pad m+1 for m odd and m-1 for m even, and the alignment holes coincide) and both specs get the check_boards b2b pair with that pin_map; a geometric pad-over-pad check is not in check_boards yet (OPEN, build/15 W2 B2B)

b2b_pin_map.rule: J209 pad nets are its graph pins, which equal b2b-nets.json contacts[].pwr_b_pin (make_spec.py b2b_pin_map stops on any difference); the map itself is pcb/prepare.py b2b_contacts (pin_map_rule, guard_rule in b2b-nets.json)

placement_rules.edges: harness headers on the board edges with the mating face outwards: CTRL-bound J202, J203, J201 and the SL3-bound J506 on the bottom edge (courtyards x 59.5-127.5), J508 on the right edge between the hole keepouts (y 11-26), the SL2-bound J207 and J204 on the top edge (x 82.5-128.5). This deviates from the contract edge_zones (mechanical/generated/contract/boards.json PWR_B: right edge y 0-35 for S02, LAB PORT and LAB BUS; top edge x 108-128 for SL2 and S04), which cannot hold these headers: the right edge has only y 9.5-27.5 between the hole keepouts for about 82 mm of headers, and the 20 mm top zone is shorter than the 45.8 mm of J207 plus J204. OPEN for MECH and PCB-PWRA (build/15 W2 PCB-PWRB): new edge_zones, harness routes, build/16 lengths and the SL2 / SL3 slot positions, and the PWR-A bottom-edge power headers kept out of x 59.5-127.5 (or PWR_B re-placed); check_boards does not check edge zones
placement_rules.reserve: the arm of the L (x 0-42, y 35-110) carries no part: it stays free for the PWR-A windows and edge strips that PCB-PWRA places (pcb/partition-budget.json windows and edge strips)
placement_rules.kelvin: INA3221 U215 between the ch1-ch3 shunts; every shunt net is scripted copper (current path plus sense take-off from the shunt pads) up to the 10 ohm INA3221 filter resistors next to each shunt; the filtered input nets E2_U215_IP1-3 / IM1-3 from those resistors to U215 are autorouted as separate nets, not as pairs (lengths in build/15 W2 PCB-PWRB), so INA3221 accuracy stays a bench gate; ch4 senses through the B2B to U216 on PWR-A

router.why: the fan-out pre-pass escaped every SMD pin with necked-down (0.1124 mm) stubs and dangling vias, and the router re-routed the scripted nets because locked copper that crosses a pad is no connection for it (route run 42414083566): fan-out off, the scripted classes not autorouted; GND is joined by the scripted plane vias of every SMD GND pad (run 42415437982 left 83 GND connections open)
